capabilities: Apply colors to combo notation wrapped in =: := delimiters
Select built-in notation profiles (asw, alt, trd) via the cc_profile property
Create custom profiles with user-defined inputs and colors
Toggle notation icons with a comboButton marker or a command palette command
Open a shorthand notation reference guide
extras: Works only in Reading view; the README states Live Preview is not supported. Points to notation.LABS as a standalone tool with additional features.
problem: Obsidian has no way to render fighting game combo notation with per-move colors, making long combo strings hard to read.

relations.evidence: For a standalone tool with additional features, see notation.LABS.

summary: Colorizes fighting game combo notations wrapped in =: := delimiters using built-in or custom notation profiles.
